response.justification: Strong, broadly experienced senior engineer (15+ years) with proven high-performance, low-latency, event-driven backend work and excellent engineering discipline (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, public speaking). However, the core requirement — modern C++/STL application architecture — is represented by only a short stint at National Instruments (~7 months, 2014–2015) and a university project; the last decade is almost entirely JavaScript/TypeScript, D, and web platforms. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL secure development, MQTT/Modbus/OPC UA industrial protocols, industrial automation domain, or Azure. For a mid-senior C++ role in automation machinery, the gap between the profile and the mandatory competencies is too large to justify an interview, though the candidate would be a strong fit for a platform/backend or full-stack role.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency, concurrent distributed systems (millions of req/s, async I/O, fibers)
Event-driven architecture and platform ownership (GISCollective, microservices, Kubernetes, Docker)
Strong software craftsmanship and mentoring: TDD, CI/CD, workshops, courses, open-source test tooling
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and over a decade old; no recent hands-on C++ architecture work
No exposure to IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity practices
No industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or OT protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3) background; no Azure

key_factors.factor: Missing IEC 62443/SDL and industrial automation domain
Proven high-performance, concurrent, event-driven systems engineering
